author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.6.3. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched.

LEGEND: the collapse arrow was a bare 1em glyph with no background, easy to miss. It is now a visible button with its own border, and the whole header highlights on hover.

LEGEND: the Device row only showed the default grey, which does not match a focused view where devices take the colour of their role instead - a device an app can command shows green, not grey. Labelled the default explicitly and added a note pointing at the row that explains the colour actually on screen.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
